data_fields.name: bar_scale_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 units (scale rounds the largest value up to whole steps)

best_idea: Show a meter as three layers: a solid fill to the value at the start of the exchange, a coloured strip for the change since then, and an outline to the maximum, so a fight can show the last exchange's loss without a number.
decision_why: Keep the three layers and the round-up scale; fix the unclamped edges, make the step data and stop the growing colour list; show only server-computed values in the strip, because the client must not predict damage.
acceptance: A health frame at 375 wide shows a bar with an outline to max HP; after a hit a red strip spans from the HP at the start of the exchange to the server HP and clears at the next exchange start; tick lines sit at one fifth of the step.
